resource.name: github
resource.description: GitHub — source of the issues this product watches. The Administrator authorizes access via a GitHub OAuth sign-in flow, and the backend polls each watched repository's issues for the "critical" label using that authorization.

config.description: Client ID of the GitHub OAuth App registered for this integration
Client secret of the GitHub OAuth App
Callback URL GitHub redirects the Administrator back to after authorizing, e.g. https://<app-host>/oauth/github/callback
